post.description:
Synchronous. Registers a voice preset and returns data.audioId immediately; no audio file is generated. Pass audioId in audio_ids of the video and character endpoints.

Returns data.audioId. Pass it in audio_ids of gemini-omni-video, google/gemini-omni-flash-1-1 and gemini-omni-character.

:::tip
This endpoint is free.
:::

audio_id.description:
Enum voice ID, used to select a preset voice character.
 achernar - female, soft, high pitch 
  achird - male, friendly, mid pitch 
  algenib - male, raspy, low pitch 
 algieba - male, easygoing, mid-low pitch  
 alnilam - male, steady, mid-low pitch 
 aoede - female, brisk, mid pitch 
 autonoe - female, bright, mid pitch 
 callirrhoe - female, easygoing, mid pitch 
 charon - male, intellectual, low pitch 
  despina - female, smooth, mid  pitch 
 enceladus - male, breathy, low pitch 
 erinome - female, clear, mid pitch 
 fenrir -  male, lively, younger pitch 
 gacrux - female, mature, mid pitch 
 iapetus - male, clear, mid-low pitch 
 kore - female, capable, mid pitch  
  laomedeia - female, cheerful, mid-high pitch 
 leda - female, young, mid-high pitch 
 orus - male, steady, mid-low pitch 
 puck - male, cheerful, mid pitch 
 pulcherrima - genderless, forward, mid-high pitch 
 rasalgethi - male, intellectual, mid pitch 
 sadachbia -  male, vivid, low pitch 
 sadaltager - male, knowledgeable, mid pitch 
  schedar - male, smooth, mid-low pitch 
 sulafat - female, warm, mid pitch 
  umbriel - male, smooth, low pitch 
  vindemiatrix - female, gentle, mid pitch 
 zephyr - female, bright, mid-high pitch 
 zubenelgenubi -   male, casual, mid-low pitch

voice_description.description: Voice characteristic description used to define timbre, style, speaking rate, emotion, and other traits. Maximum length: `20000` characters.

example_dialogue.description: Example dialogue, such as "Hello, I am Adam". Maximum length: `120` characters.

example.name: achernar Narrator
example.voice_description: A calm, clear, and friendly male voice suitable for tech explainers and daily conversation.

code.description: Status code of the request. The HTTP status is 200 even when the request fails, so always check this field: 200 means success; any other value means the request failed and msg describes the reason. Common values: 401 invalid or missing API key; 402 insufficient credits; 429 rate limit exceeded; 422 or 500 the request could not be processed (read msg and check your parameters before retrying).

BearerAuth.description: All API requests require a Bearer Token. Add the header `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY` to authenticate requests.
